notes: Assigned sources: IEEE Xplore (via WebSearch site:ieeexplore.ieee.org), ACM DL (via WebSearch site:dl.acm.org), DBLP search API. DBLP API (dblp.org and dblp.uni-trier.de) returned an Anubis proof-of-work bot challenge / 'Access Denied' page to both curl and WebFetch; per rules the challenge was not solved or bypassed. Fallbacks: WebSearch site:dblp.org, Crossref REST API (title lookups, used to verify DOI/year/authors/venue for every candidate below), OpenAlex works search API. Direct fetch of ieeexplore.ieee.org document pages returned HTTP 202 with empty body; dl.acm.org returned HTTP 403 Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge. arXiv export API returned an empty response for id_list queries, so arXiv-only preprints were not included. No candidate below combines all NeuroSem elements; closeness scores reflect partial overlap. Metadata (year/authors/venue/DOI) comes from Crossref or OpenAlex records retrieved in this session; 'why_relevant' is based on titles plus search-result snippets, not full-text reading, and should be checked against abstracts before being used in the novelty matrix.
